package.description: Honest hardware monitoring for Windows. No account, no telemetry.

en-US.description: Honest hardware monitoring for Windows. No account, no telemetry.
en-US.longDescription:
Aikonic® Clarity is a free hardware monitor for Windows. It shows CPU, GPU, memory, storage, network and fan readings as they are, and when a value cannot be read it says so, with the reason, instead of showing a plausible-looking number.
It reads CPU die temperature on Windows 11 24H2 and later through its own small, Microsoft-attested kernel driver, the one driver it installs; on Clarity it only reads, and fans are read-only. No account, no telemetry. Clarity makes two connections: it registers its licence once, on first launch, and asks aikonic.app for a small version file to check for updates, which can be switched off in Settings.
en-US.name: Aikonic
